title: Tower Maze Defense (v22)
description: A tower defense game with maze-like paths, six tower types, clickable enemies showing HP/abilities, and improved Tesla/Laser pierce-falloff mechanics.
prompt:
This tower defense game is coming along nice, lets make some small adjustments. The enemies should be click able, on clicking, we should see their HP (As a number) and any abilities they might have.

The tesla now works well, but I think it should function a little different with damage, lets increase its damage to 35, and have its first target take 35 damage, and each target after should take 50% of the damage the target before it took for level 1, and increase, eg

lvl1 - 35 Damage, each target takes 50% less damage of the previous target
lvl2 - 35 Damage, each target takes 40% less damage of the previous target
lvl3 - 35 Damage, each target takes 25% less damage of the previous target

This is also how the laser should work, however, 50 base damage, each target takes 50% less, then each upgrade that improves, from 50%, to 40% and then 20%
